This task will focus on the participating cities and will be linked closely with the replication task (4.3) for innovation replication in the regions. Dedicated innovation challenges will be supported by this task and seed-funding will be provided. UITP will support up to five European SMEs (5 sub-contracts, 50,000 each, following a call for proposals) who can contribute to the demonstration actions e.g. specific technologies (several SMEs have expressed interest, letters attached). UN Environment and UN-Habitat will support local companies and transport providers based in the partner cities (up to 9 sub-contracts in total, 50,000 each, following a call for proposals) who contribute to the demonstration actions, e.g. with local technologies and/or services and embed the innovations locally. A call for e-mobility innovators will be launched (month 10) and agreements of cooperation will then be signed between the respective consortium members and the partners. This first call will be directed to local innovators in the 9 primary demonstration cities and will aim to identify private and public sector actors who contribute to the demonstration actions (duration of the project, month 12-36). A second call will be part of the replication actions in WP4 and will be open for businesses, local authorities and public transport providers in other cities, who aim to replicate the business models and demonstration actions developed by the project. For each of these innovation seed-funding actions, concrete objectives and deliverables will be identified and partners from the consortium will actively integrate the participating local innovators and the project’s overall activities. The call for proposals will respect both local and EU legal requirements. The objective of this action is to initiate partnerships that sustain the tested innovations beyond the project’s lifetime.
